description.value: Spirit Ridge Vineyard Resort & Spa is a Hyatt Unbound Collection property situated among the vineyards and desert landscape of the Okanagan near Osoyoos, BC. The resort offers a full-service spa and overlooks Osoyoos Lake in one of Canada's warmest and driest regions, making it a notable destination stop for cyclists touring the South Okanagan wine country. Rancher Creek Road places it at the edge of a working vineyard estate.
